description: CKEditor plugin source code for the 'maximize' plugin, enabling fullscreen editing mode.

methods.name: protectFormStyles
methods.description: Removes style and className attributes from form elements to protect styles during editing.

methods.name: restoreFormStyles
methods.description: Restores previously removed style and className attributes to form elements.

methods.name: saveStyles
methods.description: Saves current styles and form styles of an element, optionally resetting styles.

methods.name: restoreStyles
methods.description: Restores saved styles to an element.

methods.name: refreshCursor
methods.description: Refreshes the cursor position in all editor instances, especially for Firefox.

methods.name: createIframeShim
methods.description: Creates an iframe shim for IE6 to prevent select element penetration when maximized.
